directions.label: Premium Clean
directions.fontPairing: modern sans display plus highly readable system body
directions.surfaceRules: flat or lightly elevated surfaces, subtle borders, no excessive shadow
directions.motifBudget: one accent line, crop, or product-detail flourish
directions.imageryRules: real product, credible screenshots, or sharp editorial crops
doNotUseWhen: highly expressive art direction is the core value

directions.label: Editorial Refined
directions.fontPairing: serif or high-contrast display with quiet sans body
directions.surfaceRules: paper-like surfaces, rule lines, low elevation
directions.motifBudget: caption, number, divider, or image crop
directions.imageryRules: curated editorial photos or work-first galleries

directions.label: Operational Precision
directions.fontPairing: single clean sans with mono for data
directions.surfaceRules: hairline borders, clear table/chart panels, restrained states
directions.motifBudget: status chips, trend lines, filter rails
directions.imageryRules: use data surfaces, not hero photos

directions.label: Presentation Storytelling
directions.fontPairing: large confident display plus clear slide body
directions.spacingPosture: safe margins, strong whitespace, one idea per frame
directions.surfaceRules: slide backgrounds, image masks, callouts, chart/table panels
directions.motifBudget: section marker, page number, highlight shape
directions.imageryRules: hero images, screenshots, profile photos, or chart visuals by slide role

directions.label: Marketplace Perspective
directions.fontPairing: compact commercial sans with clear product naming
directions.spacingPosture: room for previews to remain inspectable
directions.surfaceRules: flat previews first, perspective as support only
directions.motifBudget: device frame, callout label, badge, detail crop
directions.imageryRules: show real screens, responsive spreads, and detail crops

directions.label: Visual Philosophy
directions.fontPairing: art-directed display with reduced supporting text
directions.motifBudget: one visual system: grid, pattern, mark, or typographic gesture
directions.imageryRules: visual expression carries meaning; text is sparse

directions.label: Commerce Editorial
directions.fontPairing: confident product display plus practical buying-copy body
directions.spacingPosture: product-first, scannable, with room for proof and comparison
directions.surfaceRules: clean product tiles, visible pricing/availability states, restrained badges
directions.motifBudget: one product label system, image crop, or comparison rail
directions.imageryRules: show real product surfaces, category shots, and inspectable detail crops
doNotUseWhen: abstract SaaS storytelling without product inventory

directions.label: Systematic Foundation
directions.fontPairing: neutral sans with strict type roles and documentation-friendly body copy
directions.surfaceRules: token boards, component rows, state tables, and usage examples
directions.motifBudget: none beyond semantic state and documentation markers
directions.imageryRules: use component examples and realistic product snippets, not decorative imagery
doNotUseWhen: single expressive poster or brand campaign

directions.label: Brand System
directions.fontPairing: identity display face plus durable brand-body companion
directions.surfaceRules: brand boards, usage callouts, clear-space diagrams, and touchpoint mockups
directions.motifBudget: one recurring brand device or pattern family
directions.imageryRules: use art-direction examples that demonstrate brand behavior across touchpoints

directions.label: Human Product
directions.fontPairing: friendly product sans with compact mobile body text
directions.surfaceRules: mobile surfaces, controls, state panels, and gesture-friendly hierarchy
directions.motifBudget: one product-state motif or soft onboarding visual language
directions.imageryRules: show actual app states and meaningful onboarding imagery

directions.label: Email Clarity
directions.fontPairing: email-safe sans with compact heading scale
directions.surfaceRules: single-column modules, safe image areas, clear CTA bands, and fallback-friendly sections
directions.motifBudget: one header treatment, divider system, or offer badge
directions.imageryRules: use simple crops that still work when images are blocked

directions.label: Document Editorial
directions.fontPairing: report-ready serif or humanist display with highly legible sans body
directions.spacingPosture: page-aware, margin-safe, with strong section hierarchy
directions.surfaceRules: page grids, callout boxes, table styles, chart panels, and repeated footers
directions.motifBudget: folio marks, section tabs, or one analytical callout style
directions.imageryRules: use charts, diagrams, and evidence imagery that remain printable
doNotUseWhen: short social graphic or app screen

directions.label: Motion Stage
directions.fontPairing: projection-weight display sans with a quiet body face sized for the fixed stage
directions.spacingPosture: fixed 1920x1080 stage padding, one idea per frame, no reflow for small viewports
directions.surfaceRules: one uniformly scaled stage, letterboxed edges, raised slide panels, chrome kept outside the stage
directions.motifBudget: one entrance motion signature plus a progress or page marker
directions.imageryRules: stage-filling imagery, product screenshots, or chart panels placed on the stage grid
doNotUseWhen: static PPTX or Keynote export is the final artifact
